scenario.title: Challenge scenario cards
scenario.intro: Open a scenario, follow the customer or admin screens, and replay it with the date and profile controls. Cards 8–10 use the earlier lease and return flows described below.
scenario.card.1.title: Happy path · Aino and ebike-003
scenario.card.1.description: Aino, 36 months, no down payment, signed 5 Nov 2026. Finish the lease, confirm receipt, and inspect the first invoices and total.
scenario.card.2.title: The price lock · laptop-004
scenario.card.2.description: Quote on 5 Nov at price-list v1, lock it, then move the demo date to 6 Nov when v2 is live. Review why the net price stays fixed.
scenario.card.3.title: Tax is not price · ebike-001
scenario.card.3.description: Start a 24-month lease on 15 Sep 2026 and compare the December 2026 and January 2027 invoice VAT.
scenario.card.4.title: Calendar traps · laptop-001
scenario.card.4.description: Start on 31 Jan 2026 for 36 months. Find the February 2026 and February 2028 invoice due dates.
scenario.card.5.title: Too young · Mikko and laptop-008
scenario.card.5.description: Apply as 17-year-old Mikko. The decision explains the age rule in a clear, respectful way and blocks signing.
scenario.card.6.title: Who can sign? · Norvi and ebike-004
scenario.card.6.description: Apply for the company as an unauthorised coordinator. The signatory question routes the case to manual review.
scenario.card.7.title: Big ticket · Haapala and farm-002
scenario.card.7.description: Configure 48 months and €20,000 down. Review targeted farm, revenue, owner and PEP questions; the PEP outcome requires manual review.
scenario.card.8.title: Early exit · Aino's month seven
scenario.card.8.description: Complete card 1 first. Set the date to 5 Jun 2027, open My lease, preview the settlement and confirm early return.
scenario.card.9.title: Second life · ebike-007
scenario.card.9.description: Inspect fair condition and 18,400 km. See mandatory service, the wait-02 match, the rent and why wait-13 is skipped.
scenario.card.10.title: Third life · ebike-008
scenario.card.10.description: Inspect and recondition the item with two historic lives, then lease it again and view its passport and wear-adjusted CO₂ estimate.
